|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Plays on table. Opponent must use an additional X Force to deploy a non-unique card (other than a Jawa or Tusken Raider), where X = the number of copies of that non-unique card at that location.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Yavin Sentry (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Plays on table. Opponent must first use X Force to deploy a non-unique card (except a Jawa or Tusken Raider) to a location, where X = the number of copies of that card at that location.” '''What changed:''' added “first”; removed “an additional”; “(other than” → “(except”; “Raider),” → “Raider) to a location,”; removed “non-unique”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 25. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Yavin Sentry]].
* Later text: [[Yavin Sentry (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Yavin Sentry (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Yavin Sentry]].
